editorial:
Imagine getting out of prison and having your spouse beg you to just play it safe and live a boring life. That is exactly where you find Charles, a man who is simply not built for a quiet routine. Instead of playing house, he teams up with his old prison buddy Francis to plan a massive heist. They set their sights on a casino vault in the glamorous city of Cannes. The whole movie feels like a high-stakes game where the characters are trying to outsmart the law while dealing with their own messy lives. It has a cool, old-school crime vibe that makes you feel like you are part of the secret plan.

You will really love how the tension builds up as they get closer to the big score. The acting is solid, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While some of the plot points might seem a bit dated, the thrill of the robbery is still very exciting. If you are into heist stories, you should definitely track this down. You can try renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you really love the classics, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: After a lot of planning and stress, the big heist finally happens. However, things do not go perfectly. Just when it looks like they have won, the law catches up with them. The movie ends with a twist showing that the dream of an easy life through crime is usually a lie. Charles and Francis find out that you cannot really escape your past, and the police eventually shut down their operation for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school caper movies and clever robberies.
